subject: Please send somebody else
preview: Moses said it to God at the burning bush. God sent him anyway.
linkText: Who Was Moses in the Bible? The Story of the Man God Drew Out

blocks.text: Ever feel like your past already disqualified you?
Like God might use somebody else, but not you.
Not after what you did.
Not after how long you have been sitting still.
If that is where you are, Moses is your story.
Most people know two scenes from his life. The baby in the basket. The sea splitting open.
What gets skipped is everything in between.
A murder. A run for his life. Forty years keeping somebody else's sheep in the desert.
He was eighty when God finally spoke to him from a burning bush.
And Moses argued with Him.
❓ Who am I to go?
❓ What if they do not believe me?
❓ I am slow of speech.
❓ Please, send somebody else.
God never argued him into confidence.
He answered the fear with a promise instead. "Certainly I will be with thee."
The man who ran from Egypt in fear came back and emptied it.
Not as a prince. As a shepherd holding a stick.
That is the part I do not want you to miss.
God is not looking for qualified people. He is looking for available ones.
Midian was not punishment. It was preparation. The palace gave Moses his education, and the desert gave him his character.
If you are in a season where nothing seems to be happening, that is not proof God is done with you.
In the full guide I walk through his whole life in order, from the basket on the Nile to Mount Nebo, plus six lessons his story still teaches.
